Container.Name: MultiVibe Host
Container.Overview: Run the security-bounded MultiVibe provider Host on your own supported NVIDIA GPU. Credentials and device identity are generated inside persistent appdata; the provider agent and managed Ollama stay loopback-only inside the container. Sharing and automatic downloads remain disabled until you explicitly configure the local capacity policy.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: AI LLM Ollama provider GPU NVIDIA inference
Container.Requires: Unraid on x86_64, the Unraid Nvidia Driver plugin, and an NVIDIA GPU with compute capability 7.0 or newer. Set the Public URL to the exact LAN or HTTPS reverse-proxy origin used by browsers.

Config.Name: Web UI
Config.Description: Host port for the protected MultiVibe dashboard and API.

Config.Name: Application data
Config.Description: Persistent private credentials, device identity, policy, database and logs.

Config.Name: Model storage
Config.Description: Persistent managed runtime and model weights. Use /models/weights when creating the local capacity policy.

Config.Name: Public URL
Config.Description: Exact browser-facing HTTP(S) origin with no path or trailing slash. Use the reverse-proxy HTTPS origin when applicable.

Config.Name: NVIDIA GPU
Config.Description: GPU UUID from the Nvidia Driver plugin, or all. Exposing one supported GPU is recommended; it is index 0 inside the container.

Config.Name: NVIDIA capabilities
Config.Description: Required CUDA compute and nvidia-smi capabilities.

Config.Name: Managed runtime directory
Config.Description: Container path for the verified managed Ollama runtime. Model weights are selected separately in the local capacity policy.

Config.Name: Container CUDA device
Config.Description: Zero-based GPU index inside the container. Keep 0 when a single GPU UUID is exposed.

Config.Name: Trusted Cloud demand keys
Config.Description: Optional reviewed Ed25519 public-key map. Leave empty unless a trusted MultiVibe Cloud deployment provides it.
